summary: X Financial (NYSE: XYF) filed a Form 6-K on June 17, 2026, disclosing the resignation of Chief Risk Officer Yufan Jiang effective July 1, 2026, due to personal reasons with no disagreement with company operations. Kan Li, current President and Director, will serve as Acting CRO effective the same date. Li previously held the CRO role from 2017 to 2023. No financial terms or board votes were disclosed. The filing is a routine leadership succession in line with company governance. This is a non-transactional management change without special-situation deal mechanics or investor implications.
